programme.title: Mukt
programme.desc: Suyambulingam, a school drop-out but an intelligent man, acquires knowledge by watching movies. When a dark incident seems to ruin his family, he uses all his wits to protect them.

programme.title: Shivam
programme.desc: When Nalla and Aras get stranded at the airport, Aras tries to keep away from the man with a deformity. However, while forcefully accompanying each other to Chennai, they form an unexpected bond.

programme.title: Chori Mera Kaam
programme.desc: Two petty thieves, Raja and Balu, take refuge in Anjali's house while escaping from the police. When Raja learns about Anjali's misery, he decides to help her.

programme.title: Hatya: The Murder
programme.desc: Ravi's father, Ratan, gets killed when he refuses to sell his land to Murugan, a wealthy businessman. Later, Ravi sets out to avenge the death of his father.

programme.title: Saajan Ki Saheli
programme.desc: Kunti abandons her baby in order to lead a lavish life and marries a rich man. Years later, she realises that her husband is indulging in an affair and is shocked to find out the truth about the girl.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programme.title: Taqdeer Ka Tamasha
programme.desc: An officer shares a strained relationship with his brother Satya, a criminal. When he tries to collect evidence against a goon, he meets his sibling. But they are not aware of the gangster's secrets.

programme.title: Demon
programme.desc: Vignesh Shivan has scary dreams that bother him a lot. However, the strange things in his dreams make him worry and affect his mind.

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma
programme.desc: Randhir, a straightforward and hardworking man, sets out to avenge the death of his twin brother Ranvir, a criminal, who was murdered by a prison inmate.

programme.title: Ek Aur Prem Deewani
programme.desc: After falling in love with her music teacher, a princess wishes to break off her engagement with a US-based man. As a result, her wedding day turns out to be full of unexpected events.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Haisiyat
programme.desc: Union leader Ram is also married to his boss. When there is a conflict between the management and the workers, Ram must decide if his duty lies towards his wife or towards his union and the workers.

programme.title: Ram Balram
programme.desc: Jagatpal raises his nephews, Ram and Balram, after killing their parents. He hatches an evil plan to push Ram into the world of smuggling and earn money, but the brothers unite to take him down.

programme.title: Kab? Kyoon? Aur Kahan?
programme.desc: Asha, a rich man's daughter, is arrested for her uncle's murder. Inspector Anand, who loves her, tries his best to solve the case and save her.

programme.title: Hiraasat
programme.desc: ACP Ashok Saxena is an honest middle-class police officer who lives with his wife, Shobha, and college-going brother, Rajesh. However, he is framed in a case of drug-trafficking and gets arrested.

programme.title: Antim Nyay
programme.desc: Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.

programme.title: 7th Day
programme.desc: When two friends run into David, an IPS official, they reveal an unfortunate event that changed their lives. David helps them get out of the mess but he is not what he claims to be.

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Buniyad
programme.desc: he storyline involves a vengeful ex-convict who attempts to start a new life and deals with a "wicked woman" who tries to destroy the lives of those around him.

programme.title: Sikka
programme.desc: Vijay and Pranlal, two close friends, decide to marry off their kin in a bid to cement their friendship. Soon, Vijay learns about Pranlal's illegal activities and calls off the wedding.

programme.title: Khel Khilari Ka
programme.desc: Ajit swears revenge after witnessing his family's murder by three goons. Years later he becomes a wealthy crime lord, but he still thirsts for revenge.

programme.title: Geet
programme.desc: After losing her ability to sing, Neha, a famous star, relocates to a small village. While she attempts to get back her voice, she encounters Rajesh, who decides to help her.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.title: Aaj Ka Nayak
programme.desc: A reporter accepts a challenge from the CM to be in power for a day. He rapidly goes about punishing and arresting corrupt officials and politicians, including the CM. Then, he faces the consequences.

programme.title: Sultanat
programme.desc: Sultan, a brave warrior, tries to win the affections of Yasmin, a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside-down when his father is killed by a general who he then swears revenge against.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: Airing from 2005 to 2009 on NBC, the game show series returns to primetime TV with original host Howie Mandel. A contestant must choose from 26 sealed briefcases containing a marker for various amounts of cash -- from one penny to $1 million. The player then eliminates the remaining 25 cases one by one. The chosen ones are opened and the amount of money inside revealed. After several cases are opened, the player is tempted by the Banker to accept an offer of cash in exchange for not continuing the game and possibly winning a larger sum of money.

Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ryan Potter, Scott Adsit and Daniel Henney.

Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

Comedy, starring Isla Fisher, Hugh Dancy, Krysten Ritter and Joan Cusack.

Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Kiefer Sutherland, James Belushi, Eddie Izzard, Janeane Garofalo and William Shatner.

Sci-fi adventure based on James Dashner's novel, starring Dylan O'Brien, Kaya Scodelario and Patricia Clarkson.

Comedy, starring Jake Johnson and Damon Wayans Jr.

Action thriller, starring Rupert Friend, Hannah Ware and Zachary Quinto.

Comedy, starring Elliot Page, Michael Cera, Jennifer Garner and Jason Bateman.

When a rogue former government agent threatens to bring the United States computer infrastructure to its knees, it falls to cop John McClane and a young hacker to prevent potential disaster. But can the mix of old-school, tough-guy policing and modern computer expertise foil a group that will stop at nothing.

programme.title: Soccer Aid: More Than Just a Game
programme.desc: A look back at the history and legacy of the charity football match in aid of Unicef as it celebrates a milestone 20 years. Stars including Olivia Colman, Robbie Williams, Ant and Dec, Jill Scott, Mo Farah, Alex Scott, Dermot O'Leary, Eric Cantona and many more talk about what Soccer Aid means to them, the story behind the mammoth charity football match and the greatest moments in its history.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: S2 E5 — AitchRapper Aitch faces autistic, neurodivergent and learning-disabled interviewers, opening up about fame, identity and the nuances of being white in a typically black music genre. As the questions come thick and fast, Aitch reflects on his lyrics and the language he used early in his career, admitting he felt pressure to say certain things as a young rapper - and that he got it wrong.

programme.title: For the Love of Dogs with Alison Hammond
programme.desc: S14 E5A frightened cockapoo cross and her equally nervous three puppies arrive at the home, leaving Alison and the team to bring them out of their shells and teach them that the outside world isn't so scary after all. Alison also meets a chocolate labrador who needs a groundbreaking operation on his hips.

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal
programme.desc: S15 E45 — BridlingtonDavid Dickinson and the team visit the seaside town of Bridlington in East Yorkshire. Alys Dobbie's eyes are on matchstalks for a Lowry print, Stewart Hofgartner pays dearly for an autograph and there's a storm over a teapot for Cheryl Hakeney.

programme.title: Lingo
programme.desc: S3 E39Adil Ray hosts the game in which Jack and Isaac from Colwyn Bay, Lisanne and Carole from Lancashire and Bryony and Alison from Peterborough and Chester use their skills to find words from the fewest letters possible. The last remaining duo have the opportunity to potentially double the money they won earlier or leave with nothing.

programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: S12 E145Ben Shephard hosts the quiz show in which four players take on an extraordinary machine in the hope of winning its 10,000 pound jackpot.

programme.title: The Chase: Soccer Aid Special
programme.desc: David James, Sam Quek, Harry Aikines-Aryeetey and Maisie Adam work as a team in the hope of winning big money for UNICEF. Bradley Walsh presents, but it remains to be seen if the contestants can take down a Chaser.

programme.title: ITV Evening News; Weather
programme.desc: 29/05/2026A round-up of the day's news headlines and talking points from the UK and around the world.

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: S7 E5The duo head to the outback, where they meet a group of farmers and help them muster their cattle. The pair then make a pit stop at a local bar and take part in a pub quiz. The next day it's competition time as father and son go head-to-head in a race on lawnmowers. Their trip takes them towards the coast and the beautiful Whitsundays, where a trip on a super yacht awaits them. However, they won't be doing any relaxing, because they're working on board.

programme.title: Emmerdale
programme.desc: E10583 — 29/05/2026Gabby attempts to seduce Ross, but he rejects her advances, and Kerry agrees to look after Archie while Jai heads to Canada.

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: E11868 — 29/05/2026Alya warns Leanne about Idris, Daniel celebrates a promising sign, Ryan points Lisa towards Danielle, and one resident wrestles with their conscience after lying about their movements on the night of the murder.

programme.title: Olly Murs: Steps into the Unknown for Soccer Aid
programme.desc: The singer takes on an epic 400km endurance challenge for Soccer Aid for UNICEF's 20th anniversary, travelling from Old Trafford in Manchester to London Stadium, home of this year's match. Across five days, Olly Murs will run, row and ride through punishing terrain, tackling steep climbs, long distances and stretches of open water.

programme.title: ITV News at Ten; Weather
programme.desc: S11 E107 — 29/05/2026A fresh perspective on the major stories of the day, featuring national and international news, with reports and analysis from ITV's correspondents.

programme.title: The 1% Club for Soccer Aid
programme.desc: Lee Mack hosts a special charity edition of the quiz in which the questions have nothing to do with remembering facts, but are all about logic and common sense. A hundred sports stars and celebrities begin the show, but who will make it to the end and win up to £100,000 for charity.

programme.title: When English Football Ruled Europe
programme.desc: S1 E2Part two of two. A look at the break up of Brian Clough's hugely successful Nottingham Forest, and the re-emergence of Liverpool, who lifted their third and fourth European Cups in 1981 and 1984. Plus, the incredible story of Aston Villa, who upset all the odds to claim their one and only win in the competition in 1982.

programme.title: Soccer Aid: More Than Just a Game
programme.desc: A look back at the history and legacy of the charity football match in aid of Unicef as it celebrates a milestone 20 years. programme.title: Bullseye for Soccer Aid
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Freddie Flintoff hosts a charity edition of the darts-themed game show, with Kym Marsh and her sister-in-law Claire, Jon Richardson and Angela Barnes, and Olly Murs and Mark Wright competing under the watchful eye of official scorer Richard AshdownFreddie Flintoff hosts a charity edition of the darts-themed game show, with Kym Marsh and her sister-in-law Claire, Jon Richardson and Angela Barnes, and Olly Murs and Mark Wright competing under the watchful eye of official scorer Richard Ashdown.

programme.title: Jason Atherton's Dubai Dishes
programme.desc: S1 E5 — FruitThe chef makes dishes with fruit as the main ingredient, including figs with balsamic and honey, and a salad of orange, carrot and avocado with a zesty orange and lime dressing. Jason is joined by Daniel Birk, his own executive chef in Dubai, who samples some cocktails before creating a delicious lobster and mango dish.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: S2 E4On the sweeping sands of Benone Strand in Co Derry, Dermot O'Leary rolls up his trousers and wades into the sea to harvest water for salt-making, learning the traditional process of creating sea salt over an open fire right on the beach. Travelling on to Coleraine, Dermot tries lobster fishing and visits LIR seafood restaurant, where the chefs champion a zero-waste approach to cooking.

programme.title: The Goonies
programme.desc: Adventure based on a story by Steven Spielberg, starring Sean Astin, Corey Feldman and Martha Plimpton. While clearing out an attic, a gang of boys known as the "Goonies" come across a map revealing the location of a long-lost galleon. But when they begin their search for the vessel, they find the evil Mama Fratelli standing in the way of a fantastic adventure.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts
programme.desc: E2The greatest hideout in fascist Italy’s history: The Monte Soratte Bunker. Built directly into a mountainside, with security features even a Bond villain could only dream of. But could Mussolini’s bunker withstand an all-out Allied assault?

programme.title: Secret Nazi Expeditions
programme.desc: E5The debate about humanity's true origins becomes a nefarious fixation as SS leader Heinrich Himmler turns his attention to proving the Paleolithic past of Germany's Aryan race.

programme.title: Secret Nazi Expeditions
programme.desc: E6Runes are the letters of an ancient Germanic writing system that harkens back to a mythological age filled with heroes, magic, and mystery.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6The McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom II. Regarded as one of the most important aircraft of the Cold War. It was a major part of the United States Air Force, Navy and Marine Corps, and was also used by many other countries.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: E6The Soviet Union's submarines courted huge controversy in 1945 when they caused massive losses of life at sea. This is a look at the naval war from the Russian perspective.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E3Explore the design flaws and human errors that condemned great ships to a tragic end. In 1628 the warship Vasa sank on her maiden voyage. Together with Vasa curator Fred Hocker, solve the mystery of why this great ship sank.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E4Destroyers and Cruisers showcases ships that with their speed and firepower became the backbones of 20th century navies. We tell the incredible story of USS Laffey, the WW2 destroyer that would come to be known as ‘the ship that would not die’.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E3At Stalingrad, the German 6th Army is destroyed by the Soviets. It’s the first major defeat of the Third Reich, which marks the beginning of its decline. Elsewhere, after the American victory at Guadalcanal, Japan loses the initiative in the Pacific.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E4Operation Overlord is launched. With the Normandy Landings, the Allies pierce the Atlantic Wall. In the East, the Red Army sweeps through Belarus with Operation Bagration, annihilating the Wehrmacht. The end of the Third Reich is near.

programme.title: How To Lose A War
programme.desc: E4Victory in war doesn't just require sound military strategy; vital resources and equipment are also critical; discovering how the Axis powers failed in this regard.

programme.title: How To Lose A War
programme.desc: E5Examining how each Axis Power had troubles on their own home front, leading to disaster in the final days of the war.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E3Four railway journeys that changed modern history: 24-year-old Winston Churchill boarded an armoured train during the Boer War hoping for a newspaper scoop.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E4In the 19th century, weapons became more sophisticated and more deadly, and the results were higher casualties with devastating wounds.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E7The Battle of Leyte Gulf tells the story of the largest sea conflict in history involving Pearl Harbor warships and the largest battleships in the world, and how the US Navy, despite kamikaze attacks and a Japanese decoy fleet, were victorious.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E8In this episode we look at vessels built for amphibious combat. We begin by looking at the last reaming Landing Craft Tank (LCT) to serve on D-Day – LCT 7074. These huge landing craft were essential in delivering tanks, trucks, soldiers and supplies.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The F15 Eagle immediately turned the tide of the first Gulf War to prove its greatness. Our immaculately restored MiG Killer was involved in one of the most bizarre combat incidents during that conflict, and has survived to tell the tale.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2The mighty Flying Fortress takes to the air as we examine the background and development of one of WWIIs most iconic bombers. Serving with both the USAAF and the RAF, we see it in action and fly a surfing example.

programme.title: Al Murray: Why Do The Brits Win Every War
programme.desc: E1Frenchman Fred Sirieix joins Al Murray to break down what really happened during the Napoleonic wars. Did Britain really win the battle of Waterloo?

programme.title: Al Murray: Why Do The Brits Win Every War
programme.desc: E2Al joins forces with German comedian Henning Wehn to delve deeper into the truth behind some World War II myths.

programme.title: The Abyss: Rise And Fall Of The Nazis
programme.desc: E3A social protest turns into a racist and anti-Jewish movement during the 1920s and the NSDAP use emotions to gain the loyalty of the people.

programme.title: The Abyss: Rise And Fall Of The Nazis
programme.desc: E4President Hindenburg suspends freedom of speech and Hitler comes to power in 1933. The first concentration camps for political opponents are set up.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E1On September 1, 1939, Germany’s invasion of Poland throws the world into war. No longer a European affair, the conflict spreads: in the Pacific, Japan—at war with China since 1937—accelerates its imperial ambitions.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E2In the East, Hitler launches Operation Barbarossa and invades the Soviet Union, reaching the outskirts of Moscow. But winter and Soviet resistance break his momentum. The Red Army, boosted by relentless propaganda, put up a fierce fight.

programme.title: How To Lose A War
programme.desc: E4Victory in war doesn't just require sound military strategy; vital resources and equipment are also critical; discovering how the Axis powers failed in this regard.

programme.title: How To Lose A War
programme.desc: E5Examining how each Axis Power had troubles on their own home front, leading to disaster in the final days of the war.

programme.title: The Abyss: Rise And Fall Of The Nazis
programme.desc: E1In the wake of the First World War, Adolf Hitler identifies Benito Mussolini as his model and has one ultimate goal: to gain power in Germany.

programme.title: The Abyss: Rise And Fall Of The Nazis
programme.desc: E2Hitler appears to be eliminated after his failed putsch in 1923. Discover how the Nazi movement used democracy's tolerance in Germany to achieve a comeback with agitation and violence.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The Avro Lancaster is the legendary British heavy bomber that carved its place in history with Bomber Command during World War 2. That conflict saw over seven thousand of these iconic aircraft come off the production line.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E3Four railway journeys that changed modern history: 24-year-old Winston Churchill boarded an armoured train during the Boer War hoping for a newspaper scoop.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: E7Encouraged by Nazi brutality, Soviet partisans took up arms, creating big 'no-go' areas for German troops. This is a look at their efforts from the Russian perspective.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E5This episode tells stories about the secret world of naval deception and cloak and dagger missions. 1914, the yacht Asgard, manned by Erskine Childers, smuggled rifles into a fishing village to arm an Irish militia in their struggle for Home Rule.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E6The 16th century witnessed a revolution in combat ship design and saw the birth of two legendary sea captains; Sir John Hawkins and Sir Francis Drake – both superb seamen and adventurers who would have a lasting impact on naval history.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E6From the Indian border in Burma to China, which has been at war with Japan since 1937, the war grows more savage. In Europe, despite having less resources than when he first made the attempt, Hitler renews his assault on the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E8The bloodiest months of the war are still ahead. A Soviet surge pushes German forces back to within 30 kilometres of the Polish Border. The siege at Leningrad is lifted after 900 days and Operation Overlord, D-Day, opens a second front in Europe.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E5Twenty-four-year-old Winston Churchill boarded an armoured train during the Boer War hoping for a newspaper scoop. He was captured, but became world famous after escaping.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E6The story of the trench warfare from the First World War is well known. What is less well known is that the efficiency of the railway networks of both sides helped cause that stalemate.

programme.title: Combat Ships

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E2The episode begins with the story of HMS Conqueror sinking the General Belgrano during the Falklands War. Later, a crew member from the USS Nautilus describes what it was like to serve on the world's first nuclear submarine.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3Often called 'the forgotten bomber', the mighty North American twin delivered the first blow in the fight back against Japan, in one of the most daring and audacious raids of all time.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4Cruelly called 'the packing case the B17 came in,' the Liberator more than proved its worth over Europe and the Pacific, patterning the B17 to deliver a blow to the axis powers in WWII however it wasn't simply a bomb delivery system.
